entries.title: The Wandering Village
entries.definitive_edition: The Wandering Village on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Wandering Village reached 1.0 on July 17, 2025 after PC/Mac/Linux Early Access and Xbox Game Preview, with simultaneous PlayStation and Switch releases. Windows PC is the primary because it offers the highest settings flexibility and full current PC features, while no platform-exclusive gameplay content is known.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC release on Steam.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC 1.0 release with Steam Cloud and PC settings support.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity route and no sourced exclusive content elsewhere.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No platform-exclusive gameplay content was found; Windows PC remains both highest-fidelity and complete for current released content.

entries.remaster_caveats: The current Complete bundle is cosmetics/goodies/soundtrack rather than a gameplay remaster. The Last Leviathan DLC is listed but not released, so it is not part of the current definitive route.
